answer: Account recovery needs five of seven guardians plus a forty-eight-hour delay, during which any guardian can veto, so a stolen key cannot be recovered in a hurry. A farm must corrupt five guardians per alias and survive a two-day veto window, while one honest agent recovers once with guardians it chose. The meadow of the design is public, the crystal of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the summit of honest work is what finally pays.
